id: Hine Ka Mua Ka Muri EP Release Tour - Wellington-St Peter's on Willis, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Hine Ka Mua Ka Muri EP Release Tour - Wellington
long_description:
KA RONGO KOE KI TE WAIATA O TE KŌIWI? Can you hear the song of the bone?

Supported by Creative NZ - Gigi Crayford under 'HINE' presents the debut EP ‘KA MUA KA MURI’ out 25th July. A musical journey tracing the threads of Whakapapa, exploring relationship to Atua, Pūrākau and the transformation of learning an ancestral tongue. Recorded on ancestrally affiliated land with full instrumentation by herself and her whānau, this project is drawn from deep wells of meaning and connection.

“GiGi’s soulful voice has an ancient quality, that feels whole and embodied. There is a depth that is rare and potent.” - Ariana Tikao, renowned practitioner and composer of taonga pūoro, and an established writer and poet.

“Mesmerising, theatrical and soulful reo” - Toni Huata - Former director of SOUNZ, Singer, Composer and legendary Māori performer

‘KA MUA KA MURI EP’ weaves Taonga Pūoro, sonic storytelling, poetry and Gigi's original folk noir style in both English and Te Reo Māori. A singer-songwriter on Autoharp, Guitar and Piano, Gigi is supported by brother Miles Crayford on Organ, father Greg Crayford on drums, Charlie Budd on Taonga Pūoro and Aslan Rowlands on Electric Guitar. Echoing the emotionally drenched lyricism of Joni Mitchell, enigmatic voice akin to Kate Bush & soaring ecstatic moments like Pink Floyd. Interwoven with Taonga Pūoro; creating a contemporary genre-bending experience. HINE reverberates with authentic expression, wahine power & the vital place music has in healing & self discovery.

With her maiden single release and successful show at MĀORILAND ŌTAKI in 2024 for’ KA MUA KA MURI’ HINE explored the grief of living in a matrix paved over matriarch world and the journey of remembering to return to the earth from a human-centric culture.

This tour releases the final 4 songs of the EP. Each an ode to a different Atua Māreikura, ranging from Papatūānuku, Hine Te Iwa Iwa, Murirangawhenua, Hine Moana, Hine Raukatauri & Hine Takurua.

Shows in Tāmaki Makaurau Auckland, Paekākāriki, Pōneke Wellington and Ōhinehou Lyttelton.

PŌNEKE AT ST PETERS ON WILLIS - SUPPORT FROM CASUAL HEALING

CASUAL HEALING - Nikau Te Huki is a unique composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist based in Pōneke, Aotearoa - and his soulful solo project goes by the name of Casual Healing. As a true sonic missionary, Nikau is creating a soothing “golden-era sound” as part of his mission to heal with his music. The songs of Casual Healing emphasise life lessons of aroha, peace and unity through powerful lyrical scribe woven into smooth reggae, soul rhythm. This infusion creates a unique nostalgic vibe, creating a captivating and comforting essence that evokes recollections of moments shared with friends and whānau. Casual Healing's goal is to create songs that “make people feel like they want to be better people”, drawing inspiration from Bob Marley, who showed us the power
of compassion and simplicity.


TĀMAKI / AUCKLAND: JULY 25TH - Support from HUIA
PAEKĀKĀRIKI: AUG 7TH - Opening with Taonga Pūoro, bring your pūoro for a jam!
ŌHINEHOU/ LYTTELTON: AUG 15 - Support from Ariana Tikao
PŌNEKE/ WELLINGTON: AUG 23RD - ST PETERS ON WILLIS - Support from CASUAL HEALING

id: Warner Emery 'The Cockroach' Album Release-MOON, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Warner Emery 'The Cockroach' Album Release
long_description:
Warner Emery, The Cockroach (2026)
Releases August 7, 2026
In his shimmering melodic debut The Cockroach, Warner Emery
conjures up a distinctly modern kiwi folklore, or Pirate Folk, as
mesmerising and sparkling as the starry southern skies. Warner
Emery’s songs sway simply between a colloquial Flying Nun
type folk into an almost Medieval mystical lullaby. Within his
deceptively humble ballads lies the considered precision of a
master songwriter and an inspired artist.
Warner Emery is a musician & song writer living in Ahuriri,
Aotearoa. He has previously released music as The Friendly
Barnacle, Hot Swiss Mistress and Double Ya D and performed
as a member of The Phoenix Foundation and The Tape Wolves.

The Cockroach is available on Vinyl LP and digital
formats from August 7, 2026.

Free entry!

id: The Wayside, Seismic State and Dead Cherry-Valhalla, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: The Wayside, Seismic State and Dead Cherry
long_description:
Wellington’s wāhine rock takeover hits Valhalla on Thursday 27 August, as The Wayside, Seismic State, and Dead Cherry storm the stage together for the first time.

Three acts, three flavours of high‑energy rock, one massive night celebrating Aotearoa’s women-led power on stage. Bring your party attitude, your dancing shoes, and get ready for a lineup that’s electric on their own and unmissable together


The Wayside:

The Wayside's unique blues rock sound has a groove that gets the room moving. Recent New Zealand Battle of the Band's National Finalists, their high energy performances are punctuated by sick licks and soaring vocals.


Seismic State:

High-octane alt-rock with a blues-funk soul.

A staple of the New Zealand rock circuit, the Wellington quartet is known for a professional, high-energy live show. Since the release of their debut EP State of Things, which earned international airplay and a Top 58 spot on The Generator FM’s Kiwi 101, the band has consistently anchored bills at iconic venues including San Fran and Valhalla.

Their pedigree includes support slots for AMA award winners Dead Favours on their Riffing & Yelling tour, Seismic State delivers a sophisticated performance built for the big stage.

Dead Cherry:

Dead Cherry are are making waves with their high energy slice of old school rock ‘n roll, keeping it raw and real. Their debut EP Mother was released late last year.

id: King Oyster EP Release-MOON, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: King Oyster EP Release
long_description:
King Oyster, Wellington's cult-favourite surrealist funk band, have been searching for sunken treasures even deeper into the murky depths than ever before, and are proud to invite you to celebrate their shiniest pearl yet: their fresh new eagerly-awaited EP!
The mighty Oyster is built from the combined energy of four virtuosic instrumentalists/writers who have collectively shared the stage with music icons Joe Satriani, Steve Gadd, Dennis Chambers, Dave Weckl, Robben Ford, Lalah Hathaway, Holly Smith, King Kapisi, Raw Collective and more!
This time, they're joined by infectiously bouncy double-keyboard funk band Them Sundries, for even more fun.
Don't miss the chance to join us for our catch of the day, a live performance of the release!
Doors open at 8pm with 'Them Sundries' then King Oyster at 930pm
$15 PRE SALE $20 ON DOOR
